products.name: E-20
products.description: Invasion Plus E-20 combines a mostly mesh design with optimised vertical airflow, letting air move naturally and efficiently through the case. Supporting up to 10 fans, it keeps your system cool, steady, and effortless, in a clean, carefully considered layout — designed so every detail simply works for you.
products.heroDescription: Experience peak performance with a chassis designed for high-end cooling. The E20 series supports up to nine 120mm fans for ultimate thermal control.

features.title: Optimized Airflow Layout
features.description: Designed with multiple fan mounting positions and ventilated panels to maintain consistent airflow throughout the system.

features.title: Multiple Storage Expansion
features.description: Supports several SSD and HDD installation slots for flexible storage upgrades and faster data access performance.

features.title: Spacious Mid-Tower Interior
features.description: Provides ample space for high-end GPUs, multiple storage devices, and easy cable management for a clean build appearance.

products.name: E-10

products.description: The Invasion Genesis features tempered glass panels on the front, side, and top, offering a panoramic three-sided view that showcases your build with stunning clarity. Its aquarium-inspired design elegantly displays GPUs, motherboards, and cooling solutions, creating a visually striking centerpiece while maintaining a clean, minimalist aesthetic.
